title: Seed local users for the IETF 127 table
description: Standalone tool tools/interop/seed (mimid-seed): mints a client Identity and KeyPackages (N one-time + 1 last-resort) for named local users and stores them through KeyPackages::upload_key_package, so protocol-07 §5.2 keyMaterial for them succeeds. Needed for alice, carol, dave on mimid.reviewcommit.com for the IETF 127 hackathon table (2026-11-14..17). Works around the JMAP surface not uploading KeyPackages yet (decision mimid-1wgh.7.9).
notes: Built (uncommitted) in worktree mimid-worktrees/seed-users, branch tools/seed-users: tools/interop/seed/ (mimid-seed + mimid-seed-probe, README), plus a pointer line in tools/interop/haven/README. No crates/ changes. Stores per user: one mimi-mls Identity (persisted in <state-dir>/<name>/mls.sqlite + identity.json, 0700/0600), JMAP account if missing (no token), N one-time + 1 last-resort KeyPackages via KeyPackages::upload_key_package. Rerun tops up to N; user with DB clients but no state is refused. Safe with mimid running (WAL, 5s busy timeout, BEGIN IMMEDIATE); refuses wrong-uid, missing DB, or migration-set mismatch. Local test 2026-11-13 (mimid.test, From peer.test): keyMaterial success for alice/carol/dave, KPs verify, one-time KPs consumed (distinct refs), count=2 user goes one-time,one-time,last-resort,last-resort; carol reloaded from state joined a peer's group from the Welcome. Gates: fmt, clippy -D warnings, typos, unit tests on the crate; workspace cargo check ok. Binary: /data/cargo/mimid-seed-target/release/mimid-seed (built at 7234804; ~/.cache was full). Next: parent runs it on mimid.reviewcommit.com for alice,carol,dave; then commit.
